name: A Quick Demise extends a high-rank Serrated Shot bleed (#7192)
contract: A Quick Demise 560810 reads 'Auto shots now have a $h% (20%) chance to extend the duration of your Serrated Shot by $/1000;561109s1 sec (2 sec)'. Its proc half already ships: the spell_proc row in rev_20260921_40_ranger_dead_procs.sql (ProcFlags 64 = DONE_RANGED_AUTO_ATTACK, deferring to the record's own 20% ProcChance) uses the same shape as the proven Superb Shot row (ranger-superb-shot-auto-shot-focus), and the proc system casts trigger 561109 on the struck enemy. That trigger is a single SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION (177) with +2000 ms and MiscValue 500073, the first rank of the 7-rank Serrated Shot chain (500073, 501704-501707, 575836, 575837). Spell::EffectAscensionModifyAuraDuration resolved the aura with an exact spell-id lookup, so only a rank-1 bleed was ever extended; any higher rank (e.g. rank 7 at level 80, or rank 6 at the reporter's level 60) never moved and the talent did nothing. The fix resolves the aura rank-aware via GetAuraOfRankedSpell, which also repairs the identical rank-blind lookup behind Taldaram's Torment extension 807359. This scenario isolates the duration half deterministically: it applies a rank-7 bleed, drives the 561109 trigger as a fixture cast (the harness only submits casts for known spells, so the helper is learned first; in live play the proc system casts it and knowledge is irrelevant), and requires the remaining duration to grow by ~2 sec. The 20% auto-shot roll itself is not asserted here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Serrated Shot rank 7 applies its bleed
SETUP: the rank-7 bleed is on the target
A Quick Demise trigger extends the bleed
SETUP: the trigger cast went off
DISCRIMINATING: the rank-7 bleed grows by ~2 sec
